model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

points.quote: The Ministry of Forests (FOR) will be contracting out work to rebuild a section of the Driftwood FSR north of Fort St James from 15.1km to 16.7km.

map_readings.label: WORK SITE
map_readings.shows: Callout with an arrow pointing to the green-drawn road near the printed labels 'G5-012' and '15.1 km' on the upper overview map.

map_readings.label: Driftwood FSR
map_readings.shows: Callout with an arrow pointing to the green-drawn road on the upper overview map, and a second callout with an arrow pointing to the green-drawn road on the lower detail map.

map_readings.label: 68.5km Leo FSR
map_readings.shows: Callout with an arrow pointing to a point on a road on the upper overview map; not marked as closed.

map_readings.label: Bridge Site approximately 15km - Start of Work Area
map_readings.shows: Callout on the lower detail map with an arrow pointing to the green-drawn Driftwood FSR near the printed label 'G5-012', marking the start of the work area.

map_readings.label: End of Work Area - Approximately 16.7km
map_readings.shows: Callout on the lower detail map with an arrow pointing to the green-drawn Driftwood FSR, marking the end of the work area.

map_readings.label: Detour Route
map_readings.shows: Two callouts on the lower detail map with arrows pointing to a grey line drawn beside the green-drawn Driftwood FSR between the start and end of the work area.

map_readings.label: Tchentlo FSR
map_readings.shows: Callout on the lower detail map with an arrow pointing to a road drawn in magenta that meets the Driftwood FSR; not marked as closed.

quotes.quote: Minor delays may be encountered but traffic will be able to bypass the work area either along the FSR itself, or by using a short detour route.
